papers.title: ​When Are Experts Misrouted? Counterfactual Routing​​ Analysis in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
papers.read_scope: S2,S3.1,S4,S5.1; selected paragraphs/equations, no empirical sections
papers.verified_method: Fixed experts/model; sampled same-cardinality token routes; local next-token probability; lower-loss counterfactual route labels; final-router-only CE-gap preference training.
papers.counterfactual_state: Parameters fixed while changing selected route/gates; not a private learning update.
papers.sharing_credit: Final router only for EPO; experts/other routers frozen.
limits: Verified-success trajectory conditioning and sampled alternatives; no global route oracle.
Fixed-cell unselected-score gradient result does not prohibit route changes across tokens/representation/balance/cell boundaries.
Local token proxy is not full solution accuracy; whole comparative costs must include alternate executions.
papers.candidate_consequence: Existing current-competence allocation is a stronger antecedent; dense all-member own supervision/pool differs from sparse route omission.

papers.title: CounterRoute: Self-Routed Reasoning via Hierarchical Counterfactual Credit Assignment
papers.verified_method: One shared current policy, forced paired mode rollouts, between-mode route advantage at first token, within-mode response GRPO, self-routed curriculum.
papers.counterfactual_state: Current parameter policy fixed during paired forced-mode reward comparison; targets refreshed across learning.
papers.sharing_credit: Disjoint token-credit signals update same shared parameters; no private member parameter rows or virtual private-SGD differentiation.
limits: Explicit intervention surrogate; not unbiased natural-route gradient.
Reward-space margin is not measured latency/token cost.
Paired and self-routed rollout costs differ.
Identical within-group rewards have zero centered advantage numerator under stabilized GRPO; no automatic jointly wrong-case correction theorem.
papers.candidate_consequence: Refreshing counterfactual utility and decision-specific shared credit are already explicit; finite private-update value/recommit/mean serving differs but no usefulness/novelty follows.

discovery_only.title: Beyond Routing: Decoupling Expert Dispatch and Aggregation in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts

one_falsifiable_methodological_gap: Learning-response benefit beyond frozen/current competence allocation and ordinary dense corrective learning, with complete served/member quality and full costs.
